updates.title: CVE-2026-49179: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: A command injection vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthorized attackers to execute code remotely over the network. This poses a critical risk to identity infrastructure and requires immediate patching.

updates.title: 2 Microsoft SharePoint Server Authorization Vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-62827, CVE-2026-63512)
updates.summary: Two vulnerabilities in Microsoft SharePoint Server allow authorized attackers to elevate privileges and perform tampering operations over the network due to improper and incorrect authorization checks. Organizations should prioritize patching to prevent privilege escalation.

updates.title: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO Now Support Second Factor MFA
updates.summary: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO can now independently satisfy multifactor authentication requirements, eliminating the need for users to register a separate passkey for step-up prompts and authentication strength policies. This improvement simplifies phishing-resistant MFA deployment.

updates.title: Purview DLP Actionable Email Notifications for Enhanced Incident Remediation
updates.summary: End users can now take direct remediation actions from DLP email notifications, including stopping file sharing, deleting files, applying labels, and reporting false positives without leaving their mailbox. This streamlines the incident response workflow for data loss prevention violations.

updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP Now Protects Data Over FTP and SFTP
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP protocols enables organizations to monitor and block sensitive data transfers using these protocols from managed endpoints. This extends data protection beyond standard web and email channels.

updates.title: Purview DLP Granular Classification Error Controls for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Administrators can now create fine-grained DLP policies in Exchange Online that target specific classification or text extraction failure types such as timeouts and throttling, rather than applying blanket policies to all failure conditions. This enables more nuanced error handling in compliance policies.

updates.title: Purview DLP User-Based Alert Aggregation
updates.summary: DLP alerts can now be aggregated based on common user entities even when multiple rules match, consolidating related violations into a single alert. This reduces alert fatigue and simplifies investigation workflows for security teams.

updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP Policy Sync and Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
updates.summary: An AI-powered investigation feature provides visibility into DLP policy deployment status across devices, proactively identifying sync failures and recommending remediation actions. Admins will also see policy sync status in the Purview UI within 30 minutes instead of 2 hours.

updates.title: Purview eDiscovery Advanced Review Set Explorer with Real-Time Analytics
updates.summary: The Advanced Review Set Explorer enables reviewers to analyze large datasets using Kusto query constructs, identifying patterns, top item types, and trends with customizable visualizations. This tool significantly enhances data discovery and analysis capabilities in compliance investigations.

updates.title: Purview eDiscovery In-Product Diagnostics for Troubleshooting
updates.summary: Self-service diagnostics help eDiscovery admins identify and resolve common configuration issues related to case permissions, security filters, and policy status without requiring external support. This reduces troubleshooting time and empowers administrators to maintain their own systems.
